name: Amritsari Paneer Tikka
description: Tandoori char-grilled paneer cubes marinated in hung curd, ajwain and crushed coriander seeds.
ingredients: Paneer, hung curd, ginger garlic paste, carom seeds (ajwain), roasted gram flour, mustard oil, lemon juice.

name: Stuffed Vegetable Kulcha Crisp
description: Flaky crisp tandoori flatbread triangles stuffed with spiced potatoes, onions, and fresh mint.
ingredients: Wheat flour, potatoes, onions, green chillies, fresh mint, coriander, pomegranate seeds (anardana).

name: Chole Bhature Platter
description: Robust spiced dark chickpea curry paired with two ballooned bhature, pickled red onions and mint relish.
ingredients: Kabuli chana (chickpeas), whole wheat flour, yogurt, black tea brew, amchur, cumin, green chillies.

name: Rajma Masala with Jeera Rice

names.zh: 孜然香米配红芸豆咖喱

description: Red kidney beans slow-simmered in hearty tomato-ginger gravy served alongside aromatic cumin-spiced basmati rice.
ingredients: Kashmiri kidney beans, basmati rice, tomatoes, cumin, ginger, garlic, cilantro, ghee.

name: Dal Makhani with Garlic Naan

names.es: Dal Makhani con Naan de Ajo
names.zh: 黑扁豆奶油咖喱配蒜香烤饼

description: Whole black urad lentils slow-cooked overnight with churned butter and cream, accompanied by tandoori garlic naan.
ingredients: Black lentils, kidney beans, churned butter, fresh cream, tomatoes, whole spices, refined flour, garlic.

name: Sarson Ka Saag with Makki Di Roti

names.en: Sarson Ka Saag with Makki Di Roti
names.hi: सरसों का साग मक्के दी रोटी
names.es: Sarson Ka Saag con Makki Roti
names.bn: সর্ষে শাক ও মক্কি কি রুটি

description: Slow-stewed mustard greens and bathua topped with white butter, served with two hearty organic cornflour rotis.
ingredients: Mustard leaves, spinach, bathua, organic cornflour (makki), white butter, green chillies, ginger.

name: Patiala Sweet Mango Lassi
description: Thick creamy churned yogurt blended with Alphonso mango pulp and cardamom.
ingredients: Yogurt, Alphonso mango pulp, sugar, green cardamom, saffron strands.

name: Masala Chaas (Spiced Buttermilk)
description: Refreshing salted churned buttermilk tempered with roasted cumin, rock salt, ginger and fresh coriander.
ingredients: Cultured buttermilk, roasted cumin, black salt (kala namak), ginger, fresh coriander.

name: Amritsari Cardamom Wheat Ale
description: Locally brewed cloudy artisanal craft wheat beer infused with subtle Punjabi green cardamom (5.4% ABV).
ingredients: Malted barley, wheat, hops, yeast, green cardamom.

name: Desi Daru Spiced Rum Toddy

names.es: Ponche de Ron con Especias Indias

description: Old Monk dark rum warmed with cloves, cinnamon bark, star anise, and fresh orange peel (40% ABV spirit mix).
ingredients: Dark rum, cinnamon, cloves, jaggery syrup, orange peel, hot water.

name: Medhu Vadai (Crispy Lentil Fritters)
description: Crispy golden exterior, fluffy interior black gram doughnuts flavored with peppercorns, curry leaves and coconut chutney.
ingredients: Urad dal, curry leaves, crushed black pepper, green chillies, ginger, coconut chutney.

name: Chettinad Cauliflower Pepper Fry

names.es: Coliflor Salteada a la Pimienta Chettinad
names.zh: 谢蒂纳德黑胡椒花椰菜

description: Crisp florets tossed with toasted Tellicherry black peppercorns, fennel seeds and crisp curry leaves.
ingredients: Cauliflower, black pepper, fennel seeds, shallots, garlic, cold-pressed coconut oil.

name: Crispy Masala Dosa
description: Thin fermented rice and lentil crepe stuffed with tempered mustard-turmeric potato mash, served with sambar and two chutneys.
ingredients: Fermented rice, urad dal, potatoes, mustard seeds, turmeric, curry leaves, shallots, coconut.

name: Tamil Nadu Tiffin Sambar Rice Bowl

names.en: Tamil Nadu Tiffin Sambar Rice Bowl
names.es: Bol de Arroz con Sambar Tamil

description: Steamed ponni rice simmered with toor dal, baby shallots, drumsticks, and fragrant hand-pounded Chettinad sambar masala.
ingredients: Ponni rice, toor dal, shallots, drumsticks, tomatoes, tamarind, curry leaves, hing, sesame oil.

name: Chettinad Mushroom Biryani
description: Fragrant short-grain seeraga samba rice cooked with button mushrooms, star anise, mint, andstone-ground Chettinad spices.
ingredients: Seeraga samba rice, button mushrooms, shallots, mint, coriander, star anise, kalpasi (black stone flower).

name: Poori with Vegetable Kurma

names.zh: 膨脆麦饼配椰香蔬菜咖喱

description: Three puffed whole wheat pooris accompanied by a rich Southern coconut, poppy seed, and vegetable kurma.
ingredients: Whole wheat flour, potatoes, green peas, carrots, fresh coconut, poppy seeds, fennel seeds.

name: Madras Filter Coffee

names.zh: 马德拉斯传统滴滤咖啡

description: Traditional South Indian chicory-blend coffee decoction frothed with hot boiled milk in a brass dabarah.
ingredients: Dark roast coffee beans, chicory, whole milk, unrefined sugar.

name: Nannari Sharbath (Sarsparilla Cooler)

names.zh: 南纳里天然草本清凉饮

description: Ancient cooling herbal root syrup blended with iced spring water, fresh lime juice and bloomed basil seeds.
ingredients: Nannari (Indian sarsaparilla) root extract, lime juice, sweet basil seeds (sabja), chilled water.

name: Madurai Jasmine Gin & Tonic

names.es: Gin Tonic con Jazmín de Madurai

description: Dry gin steeped with aromatic Madurai jasmine blossom vapor, Indian tonic and crushed cardamom bitters (40% ABV spirit).
ingredients: Craft dry gin, Madurai jasmine extract, tonic water, lime wheel, cardamom.

name: Pondicherry Spiced Cider
description: Hard crisp apple cider blended with cloves, black pepper, and candied ginger (5.0% ABV).
ingredients: Fermented apple juice, Tellicherry black pepper, ginger, cloves.

name: Kolkata Beetroot & Veg Chop

names.zh: 加尔各答甜菜根蔬菜可乐饼

description: Crumb-fried Kolkata street-style croquette filled with beetroot, potatoes, roasted peanuts, and bhaja moshla.
ingredients: Beetroot, potatoes, roasted peanuts, breadcrumbs, bhaja masala (roasted cumin-coriander-chilli), mustard kasundi.

name: Mochar Chop (Banana Blossom Cutlet)
description: Delicate cutlets made from hand-cleaned tender banana blossom, boiled potatoes, and garam masala, crisp fried.
ingredients: Banana florets (mocha), potatoes, ginger, cumin, Bengali garam masala, semolina coating.

name: Shorshe Baingan with Gobindobhog Rice

names.es: Berenjena a la Mostaza con Arroz Gobindobhog
names.zh: 黄芥末茄子配加尔各答香米
names.bn: সর্ষে বেগুন ও গোবিন্দভোগ চালের ভাত

description: Tender pan-seared eggplants simmered in pungent yellow mustard and green chilli paste, paired with aromatic short grain Gobindobhog rice.
ingredients: Eggplant, Gobindobhog rice, yellow mustard seeds, green chillies, turmeric, cold-pressed mustard oil.

name: Chholar Dal with Radhaballabhi

names.zh: 孟加拉椰香孟加拉豆配酥炸夹馅饼

description: Sweet and savory Bengal gram dal with fried coconut bits, served with two urad dal-stuffed puffy pooris.
ingredients: Chana dal, fresh coconut shards, ginger, hing, refined flour, urad dal paste, fennel seeds.

name: Dhokar Dalna Comfort Bowl

names.es: Curry de Pastel de Lentejas Dhokar Dalna

description: Spiced lentil cakes steamed and shallow-fried, then simmered in a fragrant ginger, cumin, and hing gravy (No onion, no garlic).
ingredients: Chana dal, matarl dal, ginger, cumin, hing, green chillies, bay leaf, mustard oil.

name: Chanar Kofta Curry with Basanti Pulao

names.en: Chanar Kofta Curry with Basanti Pulao
names.es: Kofta de Queso Fresco con Pulao Basanti
names.zh: 鲜奶酪素丸配番红花黄米饭

description: Hand-kneaded fresh cottage cheese dumplings stuffed with raisins, cooked in mild cashew gravy with sweet saffron yellow pulao.
ingredients: Fresh chana (chenna paneer), Gobindobhog rice, cashews, raisins, saffron, pure ghee, cardamom.

name: Aam Pora Sharbath (Charred Mango Cooler)

names.es: Bebida de Mango Asado Aam Pora
names.zh: 烟熏青芒果酸甜解暑饮

description: Heritage summer tonic made from charcoal-roasted raw mangoes, rock salt, roasted cumin and mint.
ingredients: Charred green mango pulp, black salt (bit noon), roasted cumin, organic sugar, fresh mint.

name: Gondhoraj Lebu Ghol (Fragrant Lime Cooler)

names.es: Bebida de Lima Gondhoraj con Yogur
names.zh: 加尔各答芳香青柠优格饮

description: Light whipped yogurt beverage infused with the intoxicating aroma of King Gondhoraj lime juice and zest.
ingredients: Cultured yogurt, Gondhoraj lime juice, lime zest, rock salt, mint.

name: Sundarbans Wild Honey Mead

names.zh: 孙德尔本斯野生蜂蜜酒

description: Fermented raw forest honey wine infused with ginger and bay leaf notes (8.5% ABV).
ingredients: Fermented Sundarbans wild honey, spring water, ginger, bay leaf.

name: Kolkata Kasundi Spiced Bloody Mary

names.zh: 加尔各答特制芥末血腥玛丽

description: Vodka blended with ripe tomato juice, pungent fermented kasundi mustard, black salt and pickled green chilli (40% ABV spirit).
ingredients: Vodka, tomato juice, kasundi mustard, Worcestershire sauce, black salt, green chilli.

name: Crispy Chilli Paneer Dry
description: Wok-tossed battered cottage cheese tossed with bell peppers, spring onions, dark soy, and bird's eye chillies.
ingredients: Paneer, cornstarch, bell peppers, spring onions, dark soy sauce, green chillies, garlic.

name: Golden Veg Spring Rolls (4 pcs)
description: Crisp golden wheat pastry stuffed with finely shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, served with sweet chilli dip.
ingredients: Wheat pastry sheets, shredded cabbage, carrots, capsicum, soy sauce, white pepper, sweet chilli sauce.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles with Chili Garlic Sauce

names.en: Veg Hakka Noodles with Chili Garlic Sauce

description: Smoky wok-tossed flour noodles with crunchy julienned vegetables, toasted garlic, and balanced light soy sauce.
ingredients: Flour noodles, cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, scallions, garlic, dark soy sauce, sesame oil.

name: Tofu Fried Rice with Edamame

names.es: Arroz Frito con Tofu y Edamame

description: High-protein fragrant jasmine rice stir-fried in a hot wok with golden organic tofu cubes, sweet corn, edamame and scallions.
ingredients: Jasmine rice, firm organic non-GMO tofu, edamame, sweet corn, scallions, light soy sauce, sesame oil.

name: Vegetable Manchurian Gravy with Fried Rice

names.en: Vegetable Manchurian Gravy with Fried Rice
names.es: Manchurian de Verduras con Arroz Frito
names.zh: 满洲素丸浓汁配蔬菜炒饭
names.bn: ভেজ মাঞ্চুরিয়ান গ্রেভি ও ফ্রায়েড রাইস

description: Crispy vegetable dumplings cooked in savory coriander, garlic, and ginger umami soy gravy served with wok-tossed fried rice.
ingredients: Cabbage, carrots, cornstarch, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, spring onions, basmati rice.

name: Stir-Fried Asian Greens with Shiitake & Brown Rice

names.en: Stir-Fried Asian Greens with Shiitake & Brown Rice
names.hi: एशियन ग्रीन्स शीताके मशरूम ब्राउन राइस
names.es: Verduras Asiáticas con Shiitake y Arroz Integral
names.bn: এশিয়ান গ্রিন্স ও শিতাকে মাশরুম ব্রাউন রাইস

description: Nutritious bok choy, snow peas, broccoli, and fragrant shiitake mushrooms stir-fried in light ginger-tamari sauce over steamed organic brown rice.
ingredients: Bok choy, broccoli, shiitake mushrooms, snow peas, gluten-free tamari soy, ginger, organic brown rice.

name: Tsinghua Jasmine Iced Green Tea
description: Cold-brewed organic loose-leaf green tea scented with pure night-blooming jasmine flowers and a hint of wildflower honey.
ingredients: Cold brew green tea, jasmine flowers, honey, lemon slice.

name: Dragonwell Lychee Sparkler
description: Crisp sparkling mineral water flavored with sweet lychee nectar, steeped Longjing green tea, and fresh mint sprigs.
ingredients: Lychee juice, carbonated water, green tea, mint leaves.

name: Tsingtao Premium Lager
description: Crisp, clean Asian lager brewed with Laoshan mountain spring water and Australian barley (4.7% ABV).
ingredients: Water, barley malt, rice, hops.

name: Sichuan Peppercorn Plum Highball

names.es: Highball de Ciruela y Pimienta de Sichuan

description: Japanese whisky paired with tart smoked plum liqueur (Umeshu), club soda, and tingling roasted red Sichuan pepper mist (12% ABV).
ingredients: Whisky, smoked plum wine (umeshu), Sichuan pepper tincture, sparkling soda.
